name: use-clipboard
title: useClipboard
description: Copy text with the Clipboard API, with a copied flag that resets after a delay and an error when it fails.
a11y: No DOM output. Pair the copied state with a visible or aria-live status message in the UI.
A failed copy returns false and sets error; it never throws.

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long `copied` stays true, in milliseconds. Default 2000.

props.name: copied
props.description: True for `timeout` ms after a successful copy.

props.name: error
props.description: The last failure, cleared by the next copy.

props.name: copy
props.description: Copies text. Resolves `true` on success, `false` on failure (never throws).
